examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Binary control only — associate copy via an external label or a horizontal `Field`.

examples.name: Indeterminate
examples.summary: Tri-state visual. The parent owns the indeterminate logic (typical pattern: a "select all" header when some rows are selected). Sets `aria-checked="mixed"` and the native input.indeterminate DOM property.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled checked and unchecked controls without label chrome.
